segments.name: Expedited
segments.description: Provides truckload services over nonroutine routes with two-person driver teams for customers who demand high service freight and tight delivery standards.
segments.evidence: The Expedited reportable segment primarily provides truckload services to customers with high service freight and delivery standards, such as 1,000 miles in 22 hours, or 15-minute delivery windows.

segments.name: Dedicated
segments.description: Provides committed truckload capacity and shuttle and switching services to specific customers under contracted periods of several years.
segments.evidence: The Dedicated reportable segment provides customers with committed truckload capacity over contracted periods with the goal of three to five years in length.

segments.name: Managed Freight
segments.description: Provides non-asset based logistics services, relying on technology to offer freight brokerage and transportation management to customers who outsource logistics.
segments.evidence: Our Managed Freight reportable segment, includes our brokerage services and TMS.

segments.name: Warehousing
segments.description: Manages customers' warehouse operations day to day, including shuttling containers and trailers in and around freight yards.
segments.evidence: The Warehousing reportable segment provides day-to-day warehouse management services to customers who have chosen to outsource this function.

revenueModel.text: Shippers and other customers pay the company for truckload capacity, freight brokerage, transportation management and warehouse management services delivered with owned, leased and third-party equipment.
revenueModel.evidence: Brokerage services provide logistics capacity by outsourcing the carriage of customers' freight to third-parties.
